title: Business Meal Expense Template: Record Guests, Purpose and Receipts
summary: Free printable form for business meals: attendees, purpose, receipts, payments and company approval.
body_markdown:
A restaurant receipt tells finance where money was spent. A business meal expense form adds who attended, why the meeting mattered to the business and how the payment should be reviewed.


**[Open the free business meal expense form](https://www.getrally.com/assets/downloads/rally-business-meal-expense.html)** . This English form is editable in your browser and ready to print or save as PDF. Attach it to the receipt in your expense records.


## Capture the context while it is fresh


Record the date, venue and business purpose after the meal. List the attendees and their organisations or roles. A clear purpose describes the actual activity, such as discussing a specific project or meeting a supplier about an order. Avoid relying on a category such as “meal” to explain the business connection.


Include the legal entity that incurred the cost and the employee responsible for the record. This matters for a one-person business as well as a company with several teams or entities: the reviewer needs to identify whose expense it is.


## Keep receipt, payment and tip connected


The form has separate fields for the restaurant amount, a tip not already included and the total paid. Keeping these separate helps prevent adding a tip twice. Retain the original currency and record the payment reference so the reviewer can locate the transaction.


Record What it contributes


Restaurant receipt or invoice Supplier, date, items and amounts shown by the restaurant


Meal form Attendees, organisations, business purpose and responsible employee


Payment record Who paid, amount paid, currency and transaction reference


Review Company-policy decision, adjustments and any questions for accounting


If a personal item is included in the bill, identify it for review rather than silently changing the receipt total. If two employees split the payment, explain the split and cross-reference the other claim. A shared meal should not produce two claims for the full bill.


## Separate the business decision from the tax decision


Company approval does not establish the tax treatment. Countries can distinguish between meals for employees, entertaining business guests, travel subsistence and private spending. Invoice and recordkeeping requirements also vary.


The template intentionally has no preset deductible percentage, VAT recovery formula or meal allowance. Those decisions belong to the finance owner for the relevant entity. As one country-specific example,[IHK Stuttgart's business-meal guidance](https://www.ihk.de/stuttgart/fuer-unternehmen/recht-und-steuern/steuerrecht/einkommen-und-koerperschaftssteuer/bewirtungskosten-676424) describes German requirements for the meal record and restaurant invoice. Do not apply that guidance automatically to a meal booked by an entity elsewhere.


## Handle an overseas meal without losing the original amounts


Preserve the restaurant's currency, the receipt total and the amount charged to the business. Record separately any payment-provider fee or conversion information available. If the company uses a reporting-currency amount, note the rate or statement source used under its accounting policy.


Avoid adding expenses in different currencies into one total. Our[expense report template](https://www.getrally.com/blog/expense-report-template) and[cross-border expense guide](https://www.getrally.com/blog/cross-border-expense-management-guide) explain a consistent way to organise them.


## Make approval and exceptions clear


The reviewer should confirm the business purpose, evidence and payment, then record an approved amount or request more information. A missing receipt needs a documented recovery attempt and the[missing receipt declaration](https://www.getrally.com/blog/missing-receipt-declaration-template) . Keep that exception attached to the meal record.


Set the recurring rules in an[expense policy](https://www.getrally.com/blog/expense-policy-template) : when prior approval is needed, how to record guests, who reviews the claim and how to handle a split or personal payment.


## Bring meal expenses into the daily workflow


Rally's WhatsApp agent helps employees provide receipt evidence and context close to the purchase. AutoMatch connects receipts with transactions, and the platform agent helps the team work through expense tasks in the platform. Review remains part of the process, including incomplete documents and decisions that need business context.


That gives a solo business owner and a larger finance team the same basic starting point: a payment, its evidence and a clear next action.[Explore expense management](https://www.getrally.com/expense-management) and the supported[accounting outputs](https://www.getrally.com/accounting) .
